command: set -euo pipefail; adb shell input tap 503 159; sleep 2; test -n "$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r')"; adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-after.xml >/dev/null; adb shell cat /sdcard/tracker-after.xml | grep -q 'text="Paused"'; echo AFTER_PAUSED_PASS; echo '--- FINAL_LOG_ERRORS ---'; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); adb logcat -d -v brief --pid="$PID" | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|SecurityException|IllegalStateException|SQLiteException|OutOfMemoryError' || true; echo SCAN_TOGGLE_SMOKE_PASS
